"""Omarchy adapter — DATA-SOURCE COMPATIBILITY FIXTURE (opt-in, data only).

Maps a scheme's slots onto the keys of an Omarchy theme's colors.toml. It only
writes a data file into the studio's own generated/ tree. It never reads,
executes, compiles, or modifies any Omarchy installation or theme.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from .. import tokens as T
from ..color import parse_color
from . import Artifact

# base16/base24 terminal convention.
KEYS = [
    ("accent", "base0D"), ("cursor", "base05"),
    ("foreground", "base05"), ("background", "base00"),
    ("selection_foreground", "base00"), ("selection_background", "base05"),
    ("color0", "base00"), ("color1", "base08"), ("color2", "base0B"), ("color3", "base0A"),
    ("color4", "base0D"), ("color5", "base0E"), ("color6", "base0C"), ("color7", "base05"),
    ("color8", "base03"), ("color9", "base12"), ("color10", "base14"), ("color11", "base13"),
    ("color12", "base16"), ("color13", "base17"), ("color14", "base15"), ("color15", "base07"),
]


def emit(did: str, design: dict, consumer: dict) -> list[Artifact]:
    from .gpui_theme import Scheme  # shares base16 widening for missing brights
    out = []
    for s in T.schemes_of(design):
        sc = Scheme(s)
        fields = {k: sc.slot(slot).to_hex() for k, slot in KEYS}
        text = (f"# GENERATED by byteowlz design-studio (omarchy data-source adapter).\n"
                f"# Scheme {s['id']} from tokens.toml#designs.{did}. Data only; do not edit.\n"
                + "".join(f'{k} = "{v}"\n' for k, v in fields.items()))
        out.append(Artifact(f"{s['id']}/colors.toml", text, fields, "toml"))
    return out
